bottleneck: Whole-brain emulation would require the connectome plus neuron dynamics models, plasticity rules, and neuromodulatory state — and current evidence suggests structure alone is insufficient, as the fully mapped C. elegans nervous system still defies complete behavioral prediction. Simulating 86 billion neurons with realistic dynamics exceeds any plausible near-term compute, and the energy gap is staggering: a microwatt-scale fruit-fly brain versus megawatt data centers. Emulation may be impossible even in principle without the missing dynamics, and the missing dynamics are exactly what neuroscience has not discovered.
current_state: Partial emulations of small circuits exist. Whole-mammal-brain emulation is not on any credible roadmap, and the dynamics gap is acknowledged as fundamental.

title: Whole-brain emulation blocked on multiple fronts
why_it_blocks: Mind uploading — the ultimate backup of human identity and the path to artificial minds — founders on missing science, not just missing compute. Each blocker (dynamics, energy, scale) is independently unsolved.
